changelog.title: Latest updates
changelog.description: The latest additions and improvements to Arkham Online.

startersAndRules.title: New decks and Dunwich rules fixes
startersAndRules.decks: Nathaniel Cho and Harvey Walters are now available with their complete official starter decks.
startersAndRules.cards: Added the cards and upgrades from both packs, with text and images in English and Spanish.
startersAndRules.museum: Fixed encounter discard shuffling on the Miskatonic Museum agendas and Harold Walsted’s intellect bonus.
startersAndRules.encounters: Fixed Avian Thrall’s rules across the scenarios that use it, and the effects of Hunted Down and O’Bannion’s Thug in Blood on the Altar.

dunwich.title: The complete Dunwich Legacy
dunwich.campaign: All eight scenarios and the epilogue are playable, with decisions and consequences carried through the campaign.
dunwich.audio: 69 Spanish narrations with Nico - History & Documentary, including both epilogues.
dunwich.saves: Fixed restoring saves when the campaign starts with The House Always Wins.

improvements.title: Scenario rules improvements
improvements.carcosa: Fixed outstanding rules in The Path to Carcosa campaign.
improvements.choices: Improved choices between tied destinations in Fortune and Folly, Brethren of Ash and Murder at the Excelsior Hotel.

spreadingFlames.intro:
A wave of fires and strange "accidents" has Arkham on edge, and hooded figures have been seen near every one of them.

Your friend is sure they are to blame and asked you to meet at their dorm room at Miskatonic University. When you arrive, the room is empty and the building far too quiet…
spreadingFlames.noResolution:
You come to at the edge of campus, eyes stinging from the smoke, as the university burns building after building.

In the chaos you find Dr. Henry Armitage, stunned before the ruins of the library. Too many questions remain: who was chasing you, and what did the hooded figures want?
spreadingFlames.resolution1:
Dozens of students band together to fight the blaze. Dr. Armitage puts a hand on your shoulder: if you want to find your friend and whoever took them, you must leave now, and he will explain everything on the way.

You could stay and help, but it would cost you precious time.
spreadingFlames.armitageBearer: Choose which investigator becomes the bearer of Dr. Henry Armitage. This story asset is added to their deck ignoring deckbuilding rules and does not count toward deck size.
spreadingFlames.go: "There's no time. We have to go." (Resolution 3)
spreadingFlames.resolution2: Working side by side with the others, you hold back the flames until the Arkham Fire Department arrives. With things under control, you hurry to meet Dr. Armitage.
spreadingFlames.resolution3: You flee the campus with Dr. Armitage and leave the university to its fate, sirens wailing behind you on the way to his apartment.
spreadingFlames.setup:
Gather the scenario's encounter sets.

Put Your Friend's Room into play and set the other campus locations aside. Each investigator begins at Your Friend's Room.

Set aside, out of play, the 5 copies of Fire!, the Dr. Henry Armitage story asset and the Servant of Flame enemy.

Shuffle the remaining encounter cards to build the encounter deck.

smokeAndMirrors.intro:
You follow Dr. Armitage to his apartment while black smoke hides the moon. He tells you several students vanished after attending "exclusive" meetings of a group calling itself the Brethren of Ash, and that your friend left him a list of attendees before disappearing.

You decide to question the suspects and meet at Velma's Diner in Easttown before midnight. Armitage advises a light touch over brute force, but you may have no choice.
smokeAndMirrors.codex1: After a chase you find the haughty eschatologist hiding in a bookshop. He went to the meeting out of academic curiosity: the Brethren of Ash worship an ancient fire deity called Elokoss and obey a queen.
smokeAndMirrors.codex2: The garage foreman finally invites you to sit. She went because coworkers talked about a "glorious rebirth" for followers; those three coworkers have not shown up for weeks.
smokeAndMirrors.codex3: The crime boss laughs at the mention of the cult. Two of her men caught a pair of them snooping around one of her joints and something was very wrong with them, but she will not tell you where.
smokeAndMirrors.codex4: The officer relents: the cultists insisted the missing went willingly, took him to a meeting near the docks and paid him to keep quiet. They all had strange, hypnotized eyes.
smokeAndMirrors.codex5: The librarian is searching for her missing roommate and found a book of sacrifices and impossible symbols written in Akkadian. Translating it would take weeks.
smokeAndMirrors.codex6: After her show, the singer tells you two men in hideous robes accosted her a week ago, a hand with an eye on their hoods. Her bodyguard scared them off.
smokeAndMirrors.codexServant: Your nemesis lies unconscious at your feet; the flames around them have died and the mask will not come off. Perhaps it would be better to finish them here and now… The investigators must decide.
smokeAndMirrors.finishThem: They are too dangerous to leave alive (victory display; each investigator draws 3 cards).
smokeAndMirrors.holdThem: Hold them for questioning later (beneath the act; each investigator gains 1 clue).
smokeAndMirrors.noResolution: On the way to Velma's Diner you go over what you learned: plenty of leads, few results. You can only hope Dr. Armitage fared better.
smokeAndMirrors.resolution1: In the cab to Easttown it becomes clear: despite their efforts to hide, you have found the real culprit. You hope it is enough to save your friend.
smokeAndMirrors.resolution2: You stop by the hideout where you left your unconscious nemesis. It smells of smoke and the handcuffs are smashed, not melted: someone helped them escape.
smokeAndMirrors.setup:
Choose one of the two Downtown versions and one of the two Uptown versions at random; remove the others. Put Northside, Easttown, Merchant District, Waterfront District, Southside and French Hill into play.

Miskatonic University enters on its In Flames side if the university burned, or Quiet Campus if the investigators saved it (then place 1 doom on the agenda). Each investigator begins there.

Set one suspect (People of Arkham) aside at random without looking; shuffle the rest with the Servant of Flame and deal them facedown beneath Northside, Downtown, Southside, French Hill, Uptown and Waterfront District.

Place 1 doom on the agenda per investigator. The bearer of Dr. Henry Armitage puts him into play (he takes no ally slot). Set the Mark of Elokoss copies aside and shuffle the rest as the encounter deck.
smokeAndMirrors.codex1Attempt: The haughty Mr. Renfield tries to send you off politely, but at the words "Brethren of Ash" he bolts down the street, faster than he looks.
smokeAndMirrors.codex2Attempt: Cornelia Akely, on the night shift at a run-down garage, greets you with a cigarette; the moment you mention the cult, her face hardens and she points to the door.
smokeAndMirrors.codex3Attempt: The O'Bannion boss has no interest in your questions, though she will happily get rid of any trouble for you… for a price. More palms will need greasing.
smokeAndMirrors.codex4Attempt: At the mention of the cult, the officer pulls his nightstick and suggests you poke your nose elsewhere. You brace for a fight.
smokeAndMirrors.codex5Attempt: The librarian waves your questions away while pulling more books off the shelf. Perhaps the only way to get her attention is to help her find what she is looking for.
smokeAndMirrors.codex6Attempt: Margaret Liu, one of the best-known singers in town, is lost in her performance. You will have to get creative to catch her attention.

queenOfAsh.intro1:
At Velma's Diner, over two slices of apple pie, Dr. Armitage explains what he has learned: the Brethren of Ash are not conspirators but thralls of an ancient goddess they call Elokoss. A mark on the skin singles out her own, who do not even know they are under her sway.

Your pursuer, the Servant of Flame, heralds her return and gathers sacrifices for a rebirth that, according to prophecy, will happen tonight.
queenOfAsh.intro2: You search the Servant of Flame's home: an invitation to a secret meeting, muddy boots, bootlegging records from the Waterfront and a photo of three candlelit faces. Everything points to the Arkham sewers. You go down to find your friend.
queenOfAsh.intro3: After hours poring over your few clues, Armitage concludes that the ritual is taking place in the Arkham sewers. It is your only lead, and time is short: the agenda starts with 1 doom.

codex.DavidRenfield: Unmasked, David Renfield refuses your help: he welcomed her willingly. He dies laughing weakly. Each investigator may search their deck for a Tome or Spell card and play it, ignoring its cost.
codex.CorneliaAkely: Cornelia Akely stares at her bloody hands, dazed: she thought it was all a nightmare. Seeing your wounds, she offers to help. Each investigator heals 3 damage.
codex.NaomiOBannion: Naomi O'Bannion wakes up furious and demands to know what kind of party this is. As you help her up, she pays you well for the rescue. Each investigator gains 5 resources.
codex.SgtEarlMonroe: Sergeant Monroe, terrified, remembers nothing and stares at his blood-spattered clothes. Each investigator may search their deck for a Weapon asset and play it, ignoring its cost.
codex.AbigailForeman: Abigail Foreman squeezes your hands: Elokoss must not awaken. Before passing out she hands you a crumpled note. Each investigator draws 3 cards.
codex.MargaretLiu: Margaret Liu gets up remarkably calm amid the chaos and you point her to the exit. Each investigator heals 3 horror.

queenOfAsh.noResolution: Dr. Armitage barely escapes the sewers. By dawn an unquenchable fire rages through Easttown for three days; those who fled speak of ghastly faces in the flames. Of his companions, and of the Brethren of Ash, no trace remains.
queenOfAsh.resolution1: Against all odds, the vessel of Elokoss has been destroyed. Among the waking cultists you find your friend, frightened but unharmed. Leading them out, you notice a faint mark on their neck, still visible: it may wake again someday.
queenOfAsh.resolution2: Dr. Armitage chants inhuman words from a tome taken from a cultist and the burning tree crumbles to ash. The cultists are freed from her sway, your friend among them, without a trace of the mark. Even so, for months the faintest smell of smoke will set your pulse racing.
queenOfAsh.resolution3: The old sluice gate screeches open and a torrent floods the tunnels. You do not try to run: you did what had to be done. As the water rises, you think of your friend, of Armitage and of all who drowned to stop an ancient evil.
queenOfAsh.setup:
Put Underground Cistern into play. Shuffle the sewer locations and put them into play unrevealed, without knowing which is which; set Sluice Control aside. Each investigator begins at Sewer Culvert.

Check the campaign log: if the investigators scoured Arkham for answers, each begins with 1 clue; if they stirred up trouble, 1 cultist per investigator enters play, each at a different tunnel; if they killed the Servant of Flame, remove it from the game (otherwise set it aside).

With 3 or 4 players, place 1 doom on the agenda. Set aside the Fire! copies, the Collector reward and the Elokoss, Queen's Knight and Herald of Flame enemies. The rest forms the encounter deck.

brethrenOfAsh.prologue:
Arkham has never been an ordinary city: every week the paper reports another gruesome crime or disappearance, and even the most skeptical cannot deny that something is wrong.

Still, people prefer to look away. Six months after the great flood the city rebuilds and boasts of progress, but among the ashes of the recent fires some whisper that someone, or something, wishes to be reborn.

midwinterGala.intro1: On a freezing winter night, the mysterious Lantern Club has invited you to a party at its old Kingsport manor. You are handed a bone-white mask and join New England’s elite among dreamlike paintings and unsettling sculptures.
midwinterGala.intro2: Declan Pearce, the club’s nomarch, presents the night’s attraction: the Jewel of Sarnath, a gem said to grant wishes. Among the guests you notice the gaze of a tall, silent masked figure. Your invitation came with a note promising a reward for helping obtain the Jewel; at last you find your contact.
midwinterGala.contact: Choose which faction asked for your help: it is your allied faction and sets your objective. Another faction, chosen at random, becomes your rival.

contactChoice.foundation: A stern agent in a tailored suit: the Foundation
contactChoice.syndicate: A businessman with a cigar: the Syndicate
contactChoice.lodge: Carl Sanford: the Silver Twilight Lodge
contactChoice.kingsport: A bearded captain in a worn coat: the Locals of Kingsport

faction.foundation: Agent Valeriya Antonova investigates disappearances on behalf of “the authorities” and suspects the Lantern Club and Declan Pearce. She believes the Jewel may be the source of very strange phenomena.
faction.miskatonic: Dean Caldwell Philips wants to study the ancient gem, which vanished from a Tibetan monastery in the 12th century. If only there were a way to examine it more closely…
faction.syndicate: Johnny Valone offers you a deal: nobody will suspect you, so you are perfect to get the Jewel. The reward will be generous.
faction.lodge: Carl Sanford wants the Jewel for the Lodge’s collection and suspects there is more going on here. In return he promises knowledge and wealth.
faction.kingsport: Captain William Bain points at the silent figure in the corner: they call him “the Bloodless Man”, and he must be behind whatever the club is planning. The Jewel can bring nothing good in their hands.

midwinterGala.setup: Each investigator begins at the Lobby. Your faction’s Leader enters play under your control; its guests and others from the guest deck wait in the ground-floor rooms. The Bloodless Man waits, exhausted, in the Lantern Chamber with The Pale Lantern. The monsters, Declan Pearce and the Jewel of Sarnath are set aside.

interlude.foundation: Declan Pearce appears, exhausted, in the Lantern Chamber. The Jewel is attached to the Bloodless Man (or to the Lantern Chamber if he is not in play).
interlude.miskatonic: Declan Pearce appears at the rightmost second-floor room with the Jewel attached. He cannot be damaged or leave play while he holds it.
interlude.syndicate: The Jewel, Declan Pearce and the top encounter card are shuffled and hidden beneath the second-floor rooms as “mysteries”.
interlude.lodge: The Jewel and Declan Pearce are shuffled with 7 encounter cards and placed on the bottom of the encounter deck.
interlude.kingsport: Declan Pearce appears ready in the Lantern Chamber with the Jewel attached, bearing damage and doom. A new guest arrives at the Lobby.

midwinterGala.mayhem: The Bloodless Man strides toward you, staggers and falls. His suit tears open and tentacles and fangs burst out: he is now an abomination.
midwinterGala.calm: The clamor quiets for a moment. Each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or guest at their location.
midwinterGala.goodbye: The party turns into a massacre. Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
midwinterGala.noResolution: You wake up frozen in the snow outside the empty manor. You don’t remember how you escaped, but you will never forget this gala.
midwinterGala.resolution1: You see your contact’s silhouette against the moon in front of the manor. You got the Jewel of Sarnath.
midwinterGala.resolution2: Agent Antonova will report to her superiors; for now she leaves you the Jewel, but she will be back for it. You wonder whether you are her guinea pig.
midwinterGala.resolution3: The dean is delighted with the gem but would rather not keep it on campus. He asks you to bring it to his office next week.
midwinterGala.resolution4: After tonight, Valone won’t take the Jewel anywhere near Arkham: he leaves it to you as a keepsake, with a wad of cash for saving his skin.
midwinterGala.resolution5: Sanford shouts at his underlings; you pocket the Jewel and slip away. You think it is safer with you than with the Lodge.
midwinterGala.resolution6: Captain Bain puts the Jewel in your hand: he says it can do good in hands like yours. When you look up, he is gone.
midwinterGala.resolution7: From the cab you see the Bloodless Man’s face staring at you from a window. Kingsport, city of fog and legend: now you understand why.

excelsior.intro1: For weeks there have been strange rumours about Arkham’s Excelsior Hotel: disappearances, odd sightings and sudden closures. Sergeant Monroe will not listen to you. Then a man in a trench coat bumps into you downtown, and later you find a note in your pocket: “I have answers. Room 225. Tonight. Come alone. They’re watching!”
excelsior.intro2: The hotel is busy and everything looks normal, yet the warning will not leave your mind. You hurry up the stairs alone, wondering whether coming without telling anyone was wise, and knock on the blood-red door of room 225.
excelsior.intro3: The hotel is busy and everything looks normal, yet the warning will not leave your mind. At least you told people you trust where you were going. You stand before the blood-red door of room 225, take a deep breath and knock.
excelsior.intro4: In the suite, the man who gave you the note paces nervously, rambling about secret meetings and watchful staff, while a curved dagger rests on the table. He pours two drinks and hands you one. His voice fades as if from the end of a tunnel, your sight blurs… and the next thing you know, you are standing, your glass falling to the floor.
excelsior.setup: The lead investigator starts in Room 225 with the Bloodstained Dagger; the others start in the Foyer. The five Lead assets form the Leads deck. The other locations, the Arkham Officers, Sergeant Monroe and the What Have You Done? weakness are set aside.
excelsior.murderBack: The police arrive: Sergeant Monroe waits in the Foyer and Arkham Officers start patrolling the hotel. The lead investigator draws What Have You Done?. For each thing you did not cover up in Room 225 (the blood, the body, the room), 1 clue appears in Room 225 and 1 doom on an Arkham Officer.
excelsior.specialInvestigationBack: You failed to solve the crime and clear your names! (→R3)
excelsior.whatHappenedBack: The rest of the hotel comes into play and the remaining Leads are removed. For each Lead asset in play, 3 related encounter cards are shuffled into the encounter deck along with the discard pile.
excelsior.truth1: Sergeant Monroe stops your investigation, hand near his gun: everything points at you, so you had better tell him everything now. Will you tell him the truth or lie about your involvement?
excelsior.truth2: You tell him everything: the rumours, the note, the murder. It sounds crazy, but it is true. He will only believe you if you hid nothing, have at least 2 clues per investigator on each Lead and there are no Innocent enemies in the victory display.
excelsior.truth3: You lie through your teeth. He will only believe you if you cleaned up the blood, hid the body and tidied up the room, and there are no Innocent enemies in the victory display.
excelsior.truth4: Monroe does not believe a word and draws his weapon, but a crash shakes the hotel and he runs off, promising to cuff you next time. Sergeant Monroe and every Arkham Officer are removed from the game.
excelsior.truth5Title: The Police Are on Your Side
excelsior.truth5: Little by little the evidence convinces him: you were drugged and someone else is pulling the strings. An investigator takes control of Sergeant Monroe and every Arkham Officer is removed from the game.
excelsior.truth6Title: The Police Are on Your Side
excelsior.truth6: Monroe nods, convinced you had nothing to do with it, and offers to help you find the real culprit. An investigator takes control of Sergeant Monroe and every Arkham Officer is removed from the game.
excelsior.truth7: You now understand much more: you are not the real culprit. Doom is removed from play and, depending on the two Lead assets, The True Culprit becomes both the current act and the current agenda.
excelsior.noResolution: You collapse, losing consciousness among the screams of other victims. The plans set in motion at the Excelsior can no longer be stopped. Proceed to Resolution 2.
excelsior.noResolutionResigned: You fled the hotel without solving the mystery, which did little to prove your innocence. Soon the police knock on your door. Proceed to Resolution 3.
excelsior.resolution1: Days later the Excelsior reopens as if nothing had happened. Nightmares still haunt you, and when someone starts asking about the hotel you write a note: “It’s all a facade. Room 225. Tonight. It’s not over.” The lead investigator adds What Have You Done? to their deck and may add the Bloodstained Dagger. If the police are on your side, one investigator may add Sergeant Monroe.
excelsior.resolution2: You wake in the Excelsior restaurant with a glass of water in your hand, as if it had all been a dream. Weeks later a stranger slips another note into your pocket: “It’s all a facade. Room 225. Tonight. It’s not over.” If it is the first time you play this scenario, you may play it again from Setup.
excelsior.resolution3: You wait in a cell, sure the evidence will keep you behind bars. An officer slips you a note —“It’s all a facade. Room 225. Tonight. It’s not over.”— and your cell door swings open. If it is the first time you play this scenario, you may play it again from Setup.

carcosa.prologue: The King in Yellow has arrived at the Ward Theatre. Disappearances, deaths and talk of a returning king have drawn your attention. You attend the performance to investigate. During the interval, sleep overwhelms you.
carcosa.lolaPrologue: Backstage, Lola tries to leave her memories of Paris behind and become Cassilda. The Stranger watches her from afar. She cannot look away, and everything goes dark.

curtainCall.intro: You wake in the darkened Ward Theatre. The curtains are torn, the stage is empty and a foul smell hangs in the air. You approach another patron to ask the time, only to discover a corpse.
curtainCall.noResolution: You awaken outside the theatre. An old man offers help, then disappears around a corner. In his place stands the Stranger. You follow him but find only an invitation to the cast party at Constance Dumaine’s home.
curtainCall.resolution1: The police dismiss your account of the theatre and send you away. You return to look for proof, but the doors are locked. A cast-party invitation offers a new lead.
curtainCall.resolution2: You decide the police would never believe you. Returning to the theatre, you catch sight of the Stranger. He vanishes into an alley, where an invitation to the cast party awaits.
curtainCall.setup:
Gather the encounter sets Curtain Call, Evil Portents, Delusions, Hauntings, Cult of the Yellow Sign, Striking Fear and Rats.

Set aside, out of play: The Man in the Pallid Mask, the Royal Emissary, each Lobby Doorway and each Backstage Doorway.

Put the Theatre, Lobby, Balcony and Backstage into play. Each investigator begins at the Theatre.

Shuffle the remaining encounter cards to build the encounter deck.
curtainCall.escaping: You have escaped the theatre. The investigators must decide what to do next.
curtainCall.decide1: We have to warn the police about what's going on! (→R1)
curtainCall.decide2: The police won’t believe us. We have to solve this mystery on our own. (→R2)

theLastKing.intro: With no other leads, you attend the cast party of The King in Yellow at Constance Dumaine’s home, 1452 Atlantic Avenue.
theLastKing.setup:
Gather the The Last King, Hastur’s Gift, Decay and Filth, The Stranger and Ancient Evils encounter sets.

Put all 6 locations into play. Each investigator begins in the Foyer.

The 5 bystanders (Constance Dumaine, Jordan Perry, Ishimaru Haruko, Sebastien Moreau and Ashleigh Clarke) are placed at random, one at each location other than the Foyer, with 1 clue plus 1 per investigator.

Dianne Devine is set aside and the 5 Sickening Reality cards go beneath the scenario reference card.

Shuffle the remaining encounter cards to build the encounter deck.
theLastKing.resolution1: You leave the manor certain that the cast and crew of The King in Yellow are afflicted with madness. Looking back, the scene has changed: the windows are whole, the blood is gone and slow jazz is playing.
theLastKing.resolution2: A servant wakes you in an armchair in the living room. The party is winding down and everyone you were looking for is gone. Every trace of madness has vanished, but you remember what happened.
theLastKing.resolution3: Days later you remember a fantastic evening, with a hole in your memory. Obsessed with learning what happened, you head to the Historical Society in Southside.
theLastKing.forgotten: Cross out all of those names: you have forgotten what happened that night.
theLastKing.clueXp: For the clues on the act deck, {n} additional experience, divided as evenly as possible.
theLastKing.tokensEach: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag, then add 1 of each.
theLastKing.toInterlude: Proceed to Interlude I: Lunacy’s Reward.
theLastKing.interlude: The investigators must decide what to do now.
theLastKing.interludeChoice1: Things seem to have calmed down. Perhaps we should go back inside and investigate further.
theLastKing.interludeChoice2: I don’t trust this place one bit. Let’s block the door and get out of here!
theLastKing.interludeChoice3: If we leave these people alive, this horror will happen again. We have to kill them.
theLastKing.lunacysReward1: You go back inside. Everything seems normal until you see the Stranger talking to a tall man with a cane. His gaze pierces you and you flee as fast as you can.
theLastKing.lunacysReward2: You block the front door with stone benches and drive to Southside in search of answers.
theLastKing.lunacysReward3: You douse the manor in gasoline and set it ablaze, watching from the front yard as the horrors inside shriek.

echoes.introTitle: Scenario III: Echoes of the Past
echoes.intro: You head to the Historical Society in Southside: if there are records of the first production of The King in Yellow, also directed by Nigel Engram, they will be there.
echoes.sebastien: You recall what Sebastien told you: The King in Yellow came to Arkham decades ago. Perhaps the Historical Society kept clippings about that production.
echoes.setup:
Gather the Echoes of the Past, Cult of the Yellow Sign, Delusions, the 5 treacheries of The Midnight Masks, Locked Doors and Dark Cult encounter sets.

Remove 1 random Historical Society location of each floor. Put into play the Entry Hall, both Quiet Halls and the 6 remaining Historical Society locations. Each investigator begins in the Entry Hall.

Set aside the Hidden Library, Possessed Oathspeaker, Mr. Peabody, The Tattered Cloak and Clasp of Black Onyx.

With 2 players, 1 Seeker of Carcosa spawns at a Third Floor location; with 3, 2 at different Third Floor locations; with 4, 3 at different Second or Third Floor locations.
echoes.noResolution: You barely escape the building with your body and mind intact. Read Resolution 4.
echoes.resolution1: You take the onyx clasp: you know it is important. The last document you find is a psychiatric evaluation of Daniel Chesterfield, a stagehand of the original production committed to the asylum.
echoes.resolution2: You leave the clasp behind: it must be a prop from the original play. The last document is a psychiatric evaluation of Daniel Chesterfield, a stagehand committed to the asylum.
echoes.resolution3: The oathspeaker collapses and melts. Before dying it screams the name of Daniel Chesterfield, the stagehand who also spoke the oath.
echoes.resolution4: Exhausted, you take refuge at Ma’s Boarding House. You dream of a cell and a man murmuring “No mask…”; someone calls him: “Daniel, wake up.” And then you wake up.
echoes.theClasp: The investigators must decide what to do with the clasp you found.
echoes.decide1: This is an important discovery! We should take it with us. (→R1)
echoes.decide2: It’s just a silly trinket, and it would be wrong to steal from the Historical Society. Leave it behind. (→R2)
echoes.claspEffect: An investigator must include the Clasp of Black Onyx weakness in their deck (it does not count toward deck size).
echoes.cloakEffect: Any investigator may add The Tattered Cloak to their deck (it does not count toward deck size).

echoes.tokens2: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag, then add 2 tablet tokens.
echoes.tokens3: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag, then add 2 tablet tokens.
echoes.tokens4: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag, then add 1 of each.

oath.intro1: “Wake up, Daniel.” You wake up exhausted, as if you had not slept. The man from your dream looked unhinged, locked in a cell: an asylum. You head towards Arkham Asylum.
oath.intro2: Daniel Chesterfield, a stagehand of the previous production of The King in Yellow, seems to be its only survivor. He was committed to Arkham Asylum years ago, and you head there.
oath.intro3: The receptionist tells you Daniel is under the special care of Doctor Mintz, on a level restricted to staff. He promises you a meeting and the guards escort you into the patient wing…
oath.constance: Constance told you that the director, Nigel Engram, made the cast and crew take an oath, and that afterwards they felt more confident and full of spirit. Each investigator puts the top card of their deck facedown into play as a Courage asset (cost 0, no icons, 2 sanity), discarded if it leaves play.
oath.setup:
Gather The Unspeakable Oath, Hastur’s Gift, Inhabitants of Carcosa, Delusions, Decay & Filth and Agents of Hastur. Set aside the 7 Monster enemies and the 7 Lunatic enemies in separate piles.

Remove 1 random copy of each wing of the Asylum Halls and put the other two into play; each investigator begins at the Asylum Halls of their choice. Put into play the Mess Hall, Kitchen, Yard, Garden, Infirmary and Basement Hall.

Set aside Daniel Chesterfield and the 4 Patient Confinement locations. Add a permanent token to the chaos bag: -2 (Easy), -3 (Standard), -4 (Hard) or -5 (Expert).

If the investigators took the onyx clasp, use act 2 v. I; otherwise, v. II.
oath.defeated: Doctor Mintz reviews the file: the patient keeps raving about the play and insists they are only guests. His experimental procedures will have another subject.
oath.drivenInsane: Each defeated investigator is driven insane.
oath.resolution1: …And so ended the madness of The King in Yellow.
oath.resolution2: Orderlies and guards block your escape and you have to force your way through. Some patients attack the guards and, in the uproar, you escape, bruised and battered but free again.
oath.resolution3: The guards are too busy controlling the situation and restraining the patients to notice your escape.
oath.newClaspBearer: If the investigators took the onyx clasp and its bearer left the campaign, choose another bearer for the Clasp of Black Onyx.
oath.tokens1: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag and add 2 cultist tokens.
oath.tokens2: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag and add 2 tablet tokens.
oath.tokens3: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag and add 2 elder thing tokens.
oath.toInterlude: Proceed to Interlude II: Lost Soul.
oath.danielSurvived: You hide Daniel at Ma’s Boarding House. On a calm night he warns you that the King in Yellow is a being called Hastur: do not speak His name, do not give in. Hours later you find him strangled.
oath.danielXp: Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience for gaining insight into the machinations of the Tattered King.
oath.danielWasPossessed: You write down Daniel’s ravings: “Hastur.” “He made us speak the oath.” On the third night you find his body at your door, with an expression of pure terror.
oath.danielDiedTitle: Interlude II: Daniel Did Not Survive
oath.danielDied: You write down Daniel’s ravings: “Hastur.” “He made us speak the oath.” “They are opening the path to Carcosa.” And his warning: “Do not speak His name.”
oath.lostSoul: The investigators must decide what to do with Daniel’s warning.
oath.ignoreChoice: Possession? Oaths? There must be another explanation for all of this. (Ignore the warning)
oath.heedChoice: We must heed Daniel’s warning. We must not speak the name of the King in Yellow. (Heed the warning)
oath.ignoreTheWarning: You spend hours going over what you know about The King in Yellow. You are the only one who can make sense of this madness.
oath.heedTheWarning: You spend hours going over what you know about The King in Yellow. You are the only one who can make sense of this madness.
oath.markDoubts: Mark 2 Doubt in the shared campaign log.
oath.markConvictions: Mark 2 Conviction in the shared campaign log.
oath.hasturRule: For the rest of the campaign, whenever an investigator speaks the name HASTUR aloud during a scenario (or its setup), they take 1 horror.

phantom.introTitle: Scenario V: A Phantom of Truth
phantom.intro1: Months after The King in Yellow was staged at the Ward Theatre, you follow the trail of another group of investigators who ended up in the asylum. That night you dream of Carcosa.
phantom.intro2: Weeks after the asylum, you are no closer to the truth. Every night you dream of Carcosa: its black stars, twin suns, shattered moons and twisted towers.
phantom.dream1: You fall through the abyssal void of Hali, while Hastur manipulates your descent.
phantom.dream2: Constance takes your hand and leads you onto the dance floor.
phantom.dream3: The man with the moustache and the silver-handled cane pours you a glass of wine.
phantom.dream4: Smoke and embers drift into a starless night sky; the burning creatures scream.
phantom.dream5: Your reflection looks back at you curiously. “Wait a minute, this isn’t Dream 1.”
phantom.dream6: The theatre lights dim and a tentacled creature welcomes the audience.
phantom.dream7: At the Arkham police station, the desk sergeant arrests you for theft.
phantom.dream8: You look in the mirror and the Stranger stares back. The mirror shatters.
phantom.dream9: You chase the Stranger through dark corridors made of skeletons, until a wall of bone swallows him.
phantom.dream10: You chase the Stranger up a broken stone staircase into a building with a stained-glass window. “Isn’t it beautiful?” he says.
phantom.dream10Choice11: “How could any of this be beautiful to you?” (Dream 11)
phantom.dream11: You avoid looking at the window and step forward to confront the Stranger.
phantom.dream12: You look up at the stained glass. What is that shadow? What does this strange design mean?
phantom.dream13: Daniel’s voice calls out to you: “They are opening the path to Carcosa.”
phantom.lostSoulEffect: Each investigator adds the Lost Soul weakness to their deck. It does not count toward deck size.
phantom.paranoiaEffect: Choose an investigator: they add the Paranoia weakness to their deck. It does not count toward deck size.
phantom.awakening: You wake up drenched in sweat. You must find Nigel Engram, director of The King in Yellow. You pack your bags for Paris.
phantom.jordan: Jordan Perry met Nigel Engram at a café in Montparnasse, “L’agneau perdu”. That is where you go first.
phantom.jordanEffect: Each investigator begins with 3 additional resources and at Montparnasse instead of the normal starting location.
phantom.setup:
Gather A Phantom of Truth, Evil Portents, Byakhee, The Stranger, Agents of Hastur and the 5 treacheries of The Midnight Masks.

With as much or more Doubt than Conviction, remove Twin Suns and Hunting Shadow and use act 1 v. I; with more Conviction, remove Black Stars Rise and False Lead and use act 1 v. II.

Put into play a random copy of Montmartre, Opéra Garnier and Le Marais, and the other 7 locations. Each investigator begins at Gare d’Orsay. Set aside The Organist.
phantom.noResolution: You flee through the city with winged creatures above you, until the man in black corners you in a courtyard.
phantom.resolution1: You find Nigel Engram’s home, abandoned for years; the walls repeat over and over: “He is already here.”
phantom.resolution2: Nigel Engram welcomes you and talks of the path to Carcosa; minutes later you find him hanging, weeks dead.
phantom.resolution3: As the sun rises over Paris you lose sight of the mysterious figure. When you wake up, you are no longer in your hotel room.
phantom.mentalTrauma: Each investigator suffers 1 mental trauma and earns 2 bonus experience.

pallid.intro1: You wake up on a cold stone slab in a lightless underground passageway decorated with bones and skulls.
pallid.intro2: Nigel Engram’s map shows a section of the Catacombs of Paris: “Here lies the key to opening the path!” You head to the entrance under the Rue de la Tombe-Issoire.
pallid.haruko: You recognize the symbol Haruko showed you, carved into a sheep’s skull. When you touch its jaw, the wall slides open to reveal a new path. Remember that you “opened a secret passageway.”
pallid.setup:
Gather The Pallid Mask, Ghouls, Hauntings and Chilling Cold. Set aside the Tomb of Shadows and the Blocked Passage.

If the investigators awoke inside the catacombs, a random Catacombs location is the starting location; if they entered on their own, The Gate to Hell is. Put the Tomb, the Passage and 3 other Catacombs at the bottom of the Catacombs deck and the rest on top.

New Catacombs come into play to the left, right, above or below existing ones; adjacent locations are connected. The bearer of The Man in the Pallid Mask sets it aside.
pallid.readActII: Each investigator chooses whether to read Act II of The King in Yellow (at least 1 must). Each who does earns 2 bonus experience and adds a random basic Madness or Pact weakness to their deck.
pallid.noResolution: A police officer shakes you awake and leads you out of the catacombs. Days later, a faded yellow book appears in your room: the full script of The King in Yellow.
pallid.resolution1: At the Louvre you find a painting of an island city in a storm; the diagram from the burned skull appears in a stained-glass window. Its title: “The Path is Open.”
pallid.resolution2: You fall through a void into another realm, between two mirrored skies. Is this the path to Carcosa? You must find where this portal appears on Earth.

tokens.cultist: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag and add 2 cultist tokens.
tokens.tablet: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag and add 2 tablet tokens.
tokens.elderThing: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag and add 2 elder thing tokens.

bsr.intro: Mont Saint-Michel rises off the north-west coast of France. The tide is higher than expected and a storm is gathering; a captain agrees to take you to the island for the ritual that is about to begin.
bsr.ashleigh: You remember the haunting song Ashleigh performed the night it all began: "Above the city, clouds thunder and waves crash against the gilded cage… Below the earth, salt water seeps, shadows fall where the red sun sleeps."
bsr.ashleighEffect: Once per game, as a [fast] ability, an investigator may remove 1 doom from an agenda in play.
bsr.setup:
Gather Black Stars Rise, Evil Portents, Byakhee, Inhabitants of Carcosa, The Stranger, Dark Cult and Ancient Evils. One of the two piles (The Flood Below or The Vortex Above) is chosen at random: agendas 2a and 2c, the Chapel of St. Aubert and the Abbey Tower.

There is no act deck: there are two agenda decks (1a–3a and 1c–3c). Doom on "the current agenda" goes on the agenda you choose; doom on other cards counts for both thresholds.

A random North Tower, Outer Wall and Broken Steps are put into play with the Porte de l’Avancée, the Grand Rue and the Abbey Church; the rest of the abbey is set aside. Everyone starts at the Porte de l’Avancée and adds a random basic Madness, Pact, Cultist or Detective weakness to their deck. A chaos token is added for the rest of the campaign (−3/−5/−6/−7).
bsr.resolution1: You swim through the icy water toward the towers in the depths and break through a surface that ripples like a reflection.
bsr.resolution2: You fly toward the towers in the sky; the city of Carcosa looms ahead — and a force seizes you and pulls you down.
bsr.resolution3: You wake in the Chœur Gothique. Outside, two suns shine over the Lake of Hali, black stars fill the sky and the towers of Carcosa rise beyond the shattered moon.
bsr.allInsane: Every investigator goes insane. The investigators lose the campaign.
bsr.tokens1: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag, then add 2 cultist and 2 tablet tokens.
bsr.tokens2: Remove all cultist, tablet and elder thing tokens from the chaos bag, then add 2 cultist and 2 elder thing tokens.

dim.intro1: You swim to the shore of a lake that reflects two suns. Twisted alien towers rise in the distance. This is Carcosa, where Hastur reigns supreme.
dim.intro2: You land on black obsidian winding up a dark tower; above, the abbey of Mont Saint-Michel hangs upside down beneath the clouds. This is Carcosa.
dim.setup:
Gather Dim Carcosa, Delusions, Cult of the Yellow Sign, Inhabitants of Carcosa, Agents of Hastur and Striking Fear. Act 2 depends on your Doubt and Conviction: 5 or fewer in total, v. I; 6 or more with more Doubt, v. II; with more Conviction, v. III; tied, you choose.

A random copy of Bleak Plains, Dim Streets, Ruins of Carcosa and Depths of Demhe is put into play with the Shores of Hali, the Dark Spires and the Palace of the King, all revealed with their clues. Start at the Shores of Hali if you opened the path below, otherwise at the Dark Spires.

Agenda 1a gets 3, 2, 1 or 0 doom for 0–2, 3–5, 6–8 or 9+ marks under "Chasing the Stranger". Each investigator takes direct horror equal to half their sanity. In Carcosa you are not defeated by horror; with more horror than sanity, your remaining sanity is 0.
dim.noResolution: Each investigator was defeated. Check the Campaign Log: more (or equal) Conviction leads to Resolution 4; more Doubt, to Resolution 5.
dim.resolution1: On the balcony of the abbey tower you throw the pallid mask into the storm-tossed waves.
dim.resolution2: Thunderous applause wakes you in the theatre. Was it all a dream? The actor playing the Stranger still wears his pallid mask.
dim.resolution3: You wake in the Chœur Gothique. Outside, the sun shines over a calm Mont Saint-Michel, and your captain asks if you are ready to go back.
dim.resolution4: You wake in the Chœur Gothique, but outside two suns shine over the Lake of Hali, beneath the black stars.
dim.resolution5: Nobody believes your warnings. In your cell you write of Aldebaran and the black stars, and the words fade with the years.
dim.allInsane: Every investigator goes insane. The investigators lose the campaign.
dim.trauma1: Each investigator suffers 2 physical and 2 mental trauma.

bonus.self: 5 bonus experience for triumphing over yourself, the most dangerous enemy.
bonus.truth: 5 bonus experience for learning the truth behind The King in Yellow.

dim.epilogue: Months of preparation later, you are ready to unveil your latest work to the world: the finest performance of The King in Yellow ever staged.
dim.epiloguePossessed: Only the possessed investigators read this epilogue.
dim.epilogueAll: Read this epilogue only because the investigators won the campaign.

fof.intro1: A headline about a man struck by lightning twice after winning big leads you to Défis de la Roulette, a Monte Carlo casino that appeared out of nowhere amid deaths as grisly as they are improbable.
fof.intro3: After days without leads, Isamara Ordoñez, the casino singer, sits at your lounge table, warns you that you are being careless and asks you to meet her at a nearby café.
fof.intro4: Isamara reveals that a cult, the Fortune's Chosen, runs the casino, and that its leader Abarran keeps the Wellspring of Fortune, a relic that manipulates luck, in the vault. She asks you to steal it and warns you of the rage Abarran hides behind his civility.
fof.intro5: Isamara explains what to look for during the stakeout: posing as a high roller, getting a uniform, convincing her to join, winning money, finding a vent, lifting Abarran's keys, stashing supplies for the heist and playing games to weaken the Wellspring. There will not be time for everything.
fof.setup:
The Public locations (Calm Night) are put into play; the Restricted locations are set aside. Each investigator begins at Casino Floor with an alarm level of 1 and chooses a Role (Unpracticed); a lone investigator chooses two.

Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (The Man with the Ruby Ring) spawns at High Roller's Table and a Casino Guard with If the Uniform Fits… at Roulette Wheel. Isamara Ordoñez (Inconspicuous) is at Baccarat Table. The Wellspring of Fortune begins with 7 clues per investigator.
fof.noResolution: Each investigator was defeated. Proceed to Resolution 1.
fof.comeBackSoon: Each undefeated investigator has resigned: the act advances. If the investigators, as a group, possess 10 resources per investigator or more, remember that you cleaned out the house.
fof.resolution1: You are thrown out of the casino for drawing too much attention; your description will circulate among the staff and the heist will be harder.
fof.resolution2: You hope what you learned is enough. At least the staff did not seem to take any special interest in you.
fof.plan1: With the stakeout done, you plan the heist for the busy Saturday night: slip in through the public areas, sneak into the restricted ones and open the vault, guarded by steel, magic and constant watch. There is little time to rest.
fof.raiseUnresigned: Each investigator who did not resign raises their alarm level by 2.
fof.noDeckChanges: Investigators cannot spend experience or alter their decks between Part I and Part II.
fof.planChoices: For every 1 clue per investigator on The Stakeout, the group chooses to reduce each investigator's alarm level by 1 or to flip a Role to its Practiced side ({n} choices).
fof.part2Intro: Before the heist, Isamara goes over the casino map: the floor manager bets his medallion at poker, Abarran keeps a sigil that grants access to the Wellspring's power, a counter sells vent schematics, the guards have a room at the back, surveillance can be turned on the staff, a cash cart makes a hiding place, the vault holds important patrons' valuables, and the vent you found can be used again.
fof.part2Resolution1: With the Wellspring in hand, Isamara smiles for real for the first time. You leave Monte Carlo at once, before Abarran and his Chosen come for you.
fof.part2Resolution2: You escape alive, but without the Wellspring. The casino never reopens and Abarran vanishes with the relic, protected by someone powerful.
fof.part2Resolution3: You wake in an empty casino: no one is left and the Wellspring is gone. The casino closes for good and Abarran disappears.
fof.part2NoResolution: Each investigator was defeated. Proceed to Resolution 3.
fof.relicAcquired: Abarran appears in the doorway, shaking with fury: his civility is gone. He moves to Relic Room.
fof.relicFallen: Abarran, nearly defeated, triggers a mechanism before collapsing and the steel ceiling starts to fall. Each investigator tests [agility] (3); those who fail take 2 damage.
fof.disfavor: The relic brings misfortune to those it does not favor: in the middle of the heist, everything turns upside-down.
fof.lightsOut: The casino goes dark: each location gets +1 shroud, and triggering its abilities costs an additional action or 1 horror. At Security Office, power can be restored to the public or staff area by spending 1 clue per investigator.
fof.unlikelyInjuries: A chain of unlikely accidents: each investigator checks 1 icon and suffers an injury by suit (♥ one move, ♦ one investigate, ♣ one fight, ♠ one activate action per turn). [fast] Take 1 damage or 1 horror to ignore it this turn.
fof.personalEntanglement: Someone from the lead investigator's past works at the casino and Abarran knows it. At Owner's Office, 1 clue per investigator as a group rescues them; at 6 horror, the lead investigator suffers 1 mental trauma and everyone takes 2 direct horror.
fof.bluffCalled: The Dimensional Shambler spawns at Roulette Wheel and Plan in Shambles joins the encounter deck. Each investigator raises their alarm level by 1.
fof.setup2: The Restricted group (unrevealed) and the Public group on its Busy Night side are put into play. Each investigator begins at Casino Floor with their recorded alarm level, Roles and stashed cards. A Casino Guard spawns at High Roller's Table and a Security Patrol at Casino Floor. Isamara (Crew) is at Casino Lounge if you convinced her; the Cash Cart is at High Roller's Table if you cleaned out the house.
fof.badLuckToken: Fortune's Chosen have bound you with bad luck: in a campaign, replace a number token in the chaos bag with one of a value 2 lower.
fof.tasksDone: Heist tasks completed: {n}. Each task beyond 4 grants 1 bonus experience; at 5, Isamara (if still in play), and at 6, the Deck of Possibilities.

dunwich.prologue: Dr. Henry Armitage asks for your help: his colleagues Warren Rice and Francis Morgan have disappeared. Rice was last seen at Miskatonic University’s Humanities department; Morgan has been frequenting the Clover Club. Decide whom to look for first.

extracurricular.intro: Dr. Armitage is worried his colleague, Professor Warren Rice, might be in trouble, so he has asked for your help in finding his friend. He seems unreasonably nervous about his colleague’s disappearance considering Professor Rice has only been “missing” for a matter of hours…
extracurricular.setup: Gather Extracurricular Activity, Sorcery, The Beyond, Bishop’s Thralls, Whippoorwills, Ancient Evils, Locked Doors and Agents of Yog-Sothoth. Use Faculty Offices (The Night is Still Young) when searching for Rice first; otherwise use The Hour is Late. Set aside Jazz Mulligan, Alchemical Concoction, The Experiment, Professor Warren Rice, Dormitories and Alchemy Labs. Put the Quad, Orne Library, Humanities, Student Union, Science and Administration into play. All investigators start at the Quad.
extracurricular.noResolution: As you flee from the university, you hear screaming from the northern end of the campus. An ambulance passes you by, and you fear the worst. Hours later, you learn that a ‘rabid dog of some sort’ found its way into the university dormitories. The creature attacked the students inside and many were mauled or killed in the attack.
extracurricular.resolution1: You find Professor Rice bound and gagged in the closet of his office. When you free him, he informs you that the strange men and women wandering around the campus had been stalking him for hours. They cornered him in his office and tied him up, although for what purpose, Rice isn’t sure. You inform him that Dr. Armitage sent you, and Rice looks relieved, although he suspects that Dr. Morgan might be in danger as well. Because the strangers on campus seem to have been targeting Professor Rice, you decide that the best course of action is to escort him away from the campus as quickly as possible. As you leave the university, you hear screaming from the northern end of the campus. An ambulance passes you by, and you fear the worst. Hours later, you learn that a ‘rabid dog of some sort’ found its way into the university dormitories. The creature attacked the students inside, and many were mauled or killed in the attack.
extracurricular.resolution2: You pull each of the dormitory’s fire alarms and usher the students out of the building’s north exit, hoping to make your way off campus. Many of the students are confused and exhausted, but you believe an attempt to explain the situation will do more harm than good. Minutes later, a terrible screech echoes across the campus, piercing and shrill. You tell the students to wait and head back to the dormitories to investigate. Oddly, you find no trace of the strange creature—a prospect that worries you more than it relieves you. You hurry to the faculty offices to find Professor Rice, but there is no sign of him anywhere.
extracurricular.resolution3: After defeating the strange and terrifying creature from the Department of Alchemy, you rush to the faculty offices to find Professor Rice. By the time you get to his office, there is no sign of him anywhere.
extracurricular.resolution4: You awaken hours later, exhausted and injured. You’re not sure what you saw, but the sight of it filled your mind with terror. From other survivors, you learn that a ‘rabid dog of some sort’ found its way into the university dormitories. The creature attacked the students inside, and many were mauled or killed in the attack.
extracurricular.riceReward: One investigator may add Professor Warren Rice to their deck. He does not count towards deck size.
extracurricular.tabletEffect: Add one tablet token to the chaos bag for the rest of the campaign.

house.intro: Dr. Armitage suggested you track down his associate Dr. Francis Morgan. He’s not sure whether Dr. Morgan is in trouble, but he’s not particularly happy with his colleague’s present choice of company. He’s in the Clover Club, a notorious gambling joint somewhere downtown. Finding the club’s exact location isn’t easy—you have to grease a few palms just to learn which of the Downtown restaurants operates as the club’s front. That restaurant is La Bella Luna, a somewhat upscale Italian eatery by the theatre. You change into your Sunday best and make your way there. In front of La Bella Luna stands a man in a pinstripe suit who sizes you up as you approach. “Enjoy yourselves,” he says with a snake-like grin as he holds open the restaurant’s front door.
house.introTitle: Scenario I-B: The House Always Wins
house.resolution1: You flee to the end of the block and pause to recover. Before you can catch your breath, the ground shakes with a thunderous crash. People emerge from their homes and storefronts to see what the ruckus is, and a crowd forms on the street. You head to the front of the crowd and are horrified to see the building from which you fled just minutes earlier reduced to rubble. There is no sign of Dr. Morgan anywhere.
house.resolution2: “What in the world…?” Dr. Morgan finally breaks out of his daze as you make your way to safety. You ask him what he remembers, and he sputters and shakes his head. “It’s all a haze,” he explains, visibly exhausted. “I was having the run of my life! Perhaps I had one too many shots. But, those creatures—I haven’t seen anything like that since…” He trails off, and you can tell that his mind is racing. His eyes widen with realization and his face pales. “I may not be in the best shape, but I’ll help with your investigation. Whatever it takes.”
house.resolution3: Although you were unable to find Dr. Morgan in the club, the man you rescued is grateful for your help. He introduces himself as Peter Clover, the owner of the establishment you’d just left. Despite the situation, he maintains an air of quiet professionalism. As you make your way towards the street, a well-polished Chrysler B-70 rolls up to you, and a gorgeous woman with long brown hair and narrow eyes exits. She is flanked by dangerous-looking men who slip their hands under their suit jackets when they see you. “Peter,” she says with a sigh of relief, “Good, you’re okay. I heard there was trouble?” She turns and glares at you with deadly eyes. “Who are they?” Mr. Clover dusts off his vest, unworried. “Naomi, my dear, these are friends of mine. They…” he clears his throat. “They escorted me off the premises,” he explains after a short pause. “They have earned our gratitude.” The woman crosses her arms and takes a moment to size you up before giving you a smirk. “Very well then. I must thank you for taking care of Peter. Run along now; we’ll handle things from here.” She nods to the goons flanking her and they walk past you toward the club’s rear entrance, pulling firearms out from underneath their coats. You’re not sure what ‘handling things’ means, but you’re pretty sure you don’t want to be here when the gunfire starts. You thank Naomi and Peter, and head off.
house.resolution4: You are pulled from the debris by several firefighters, one of whom exclaims, “We’ve got a live one!” A few of them patch you up, and the cops ask you what happened. You’re certain they wouldn’t believe your story about horrible monstrosities demolishing the building from within. Unsure of what to say, you give a vague statement about not remembering much. “We’re bringing you to St. Mary’s,” one of the nurses says, pointing to a nearby ambulance. Knowing now how dire the situation is, you slip away while she is distracted by something else in the rubble…
house.armitage1: You are more than a little rattled by your experiences in the university and the Clover Club. You’re not sure what to make of whoever—or whatever—was after Rice and Morgan. Worried about Dr. Armitage, you swiftly make your way back to his home. When you arrive, you find that the latches of his front door have been busted open, and his living area and study have been ransacked. Dr. Armitage is nowhere to be found. Searching his home, you find a journal the intruders didn’t steal tucked beneath several other documents in the bottom drawer of Armitage’s desk. The journal appears to be written in a strange language you cannot decode, using a script you’ve never seen in your entire life. Fortunately, it seems Dr. Armitage had already gone through the trouble of translating it into English. Apparently, it belongs to one “Wilbur Whateley.” The journal—along with Armitage’s many notes—tells a startling tale, one you would scarcely believe had it not been for your harrowing experiences earlier tonight…
house.armitage2: When you arrive at Dr. Armitage’s home in Southside, you find him sitting at his desk, pale-faced and sweating with worry. He is grateful to you for searching for his colleagues, but he doesn’t look relieved. With a long pause, he straightens his glasses and explains: “I’m afraid I must apologize. There’s something I didn’t mention to you earlier.” Dr. Armitage then spins a tale you would scarcely believe had it not been for your harrowing experiences earlier that night…
house.setup: Gather The House Always Wins, Bad Luck, Naomi’s Crew and Rats. Set Hideous Abominations and Striking Fear aside. Start at La Bella Luna with the Lounge, Bar and Cardroom in play. Spawn the Pit Boss in the Lounge. Set Darkened Hall, the three Back Hall Doorways, Peter Clover and Dr. Francis Morgan aside.

doomed.title: Doomed
doomed.body: When a doomed enemy is defeated (by an investigator or an effect), place 1 doom on the agenda, which can make it advance. Discarding it does not count as defeating it.

hunter.title: Hunter
hunter.body: At the start of the enemy phase, each ready, unengaged hunter moves one location along the shortest path toward the nearest investigator. It does not move if an investigator is already at its location. On a tie, its prey decides, otherwise the lead.

peril.title: Peril
peril.body: While you resolve a card with peril, you cannot confer with the group and nobody else can play cards, trigger abilities or commit cards to your tests.

prey.title: Prey
prey.body: Some enemies pursue a specific investigator: among several at the same distance (or at its location), they choose the one who best fits their prey.

retaliate.title: Retaliate
retaliate.body: If you fail a test while attacking a ready enemy with retaliate, it attacks you after results are applied (engaged with you or not). It does not exhaust for this.

surge.title: Surge
surge.body: After you draw and resolve an encounter card with surge, draw and resolve another one.

codex.title: The codex
codex.body: Some cards refer to a numbered codex entry. When triggered, its text is read and its instructions resolved; the table shows it in a window.

alert.title: Alert
alert.body: If you fail a test while evading an enemy with alert, it attacks you after results are applied. It does not exhaust for this.

aloof.title: Aloof
aloof.body: An aloof enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location; you must engage it with an action (or an effect).

elusive.title: Elusive
elusive.body: After an elusive enemy is attacked (and not defeated) or evaded, it moves away to a connecting location, without investigators if possible, and disengages.

massive.title: Massive
massive.body: A ready massive enemy counts as engaged with each investigator at its location, attacks all of them in the enemy phase and only exhausts after all its attacks. It cannot be placed in a threat area.

patrol.title: Patrol
patrol.body: In the enemy phase (step 3.2), each ready, unengaged patrol enemy moves one location along the shortest path toward its destination (The Bloodless Man: the nearest location with a guest). With several destinations, the lead decides.

guests.title: Guests
guests.body: Guests are story assets waiting at locations. Parley with them (a test of one of their icons, difficulty 3) to take control; they take no ally slot. Only their controller can use their abilities.

spellbound.title: Spellbound
spellbound.body: A spellbound guest is placed facedown at its location, with no controller and no damage or horror. A Leader that would become spellbound is removed from the game instead. Flipping it faceup readies it and ends the spell.

score.title: Score
score.body: At the end of the game you score tasks: manor locations with no clues, guests controlled, no spellbound cards, ending on agenda 1 or 2, key enemies in the victory display, little damage or horror, difficulty and your faction points. Every 10 points give 1 experience (5 at most).

excelsiorPatrol.title: Patrol
excelsiorPatrol.body: In the enemy phase (step 3.2), each ready, unengaged patrol enemy moves one location along the shortest path toward its designated location (Arkham Officer: nearest location with clues; Hotel Guest: nearest Crime Scene; Vengeful Specter: Room 245). With several options, the lead decides; it does not move into a location blocked by a card ability.

parley.title: Parley
parley.body: Some enemies have a parley action ability. Parleying does not provoke attacks of opportunity. What Have You Done? adds a cost: discard a random card from your hand.

leads.title: Leads
leads.body: The five Lead assets form the Leads deck. Spend clues to draw them; once you control two, the act advances. Some locations let you move clues onto Lead assets: the more clues, the better the evidence for the police.

trueCulprit.title: The True Culprit
trueCulprit.body: After the interlude, one of ten versions of The True Culprit becomes both the current act and the current agenda, depending on your two Leads. Reaching its doom threshold leads to Resolution 2; completing its objective, to Resolution 1.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.body: A hidden card is secretly added to your hand. While there it is treated as if it were in your threat area: its abilities work, but only you can trigger them. It counts toward your hand size and can only be discarded as its own text describes; then it goes to the encounter discard pile.

bystanders.title: Bystanders
bystanders.body: Bystander assets are at locations, uncontrolled, with clues on them. Parley with them to take their clues (parleying does not provoke attacks of opportunity). When the last clue is removed from a bystander, they have been interviewed.

fofAlarm.title: Alarm level
fofAlarm.body: Each investigator has an alarm level from 1 to 10, starting at 1 (shown next to their resources). It is not doom. Each Casino enemy at the location of an investigator with an alarm level of 6 or higher loses aloof.

fofPatrol.title: Patrol
fofPatrol.body: In the enemy phase (step 3.2), each ready, unengaged enemy with patrol moves one location toward its patrol location. "Clockwise" and "counterclockwise" follow the ring of its location group (Public or Restricted).

fofGameIcons.title: Game icons
fofGameIcons.body: To check game icons, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck and look at their color, suit and rank (J, Q and K are worth 10; ♥ and ♦ are red). Cards without an icon are set aside and replaced. "Sequential rank" means consecutive ranks.

fofMulligan.title: Mulligan
fofMulligan.body: After checking, you may set aside any of the discarded cards and discard as many new ones in their place.

fofRoles.title: Roles
fofRoles.body: The Face, The Muscle, The Thief and The Grifter are two-sided story assets: Unpracticed and Practiced. The Thief can be used at the start of the enemy phase, before patrols move.

fofWellspring.title: The Wellspring of Fortune
fofWellspring.body: In this scenario the Wellspring is only a clue counter and an objective; its text is blank. Each Game location ability you trigger removes 1 clue from it (2 if you gained resources).

fofHeist.title: The Heist
fofHeist.body: The Heist story card lists 8 tasks. You cannot enter Vault Door until at least 4 are completed. Relic Room cannot be entered until it is revealed from Vault Door; taking the Wellspring there advances the act, and the investigator who holds it must resign to win.
